items.title: 貝森特恐成美股牛市最大敵人！日元、美債夾擊多頭
items.title_en: Biden May Become the Biggest Threat to the US Stock Bull Market: Yen and US Bonds Squeeze Bulls
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，美國財長貝森特近期分別介入美債與日元市場，原意是壓低長期利率並阻止日元持續貶值，卻意外形成「美債殖利率走高、日元升值」的組合。市場人士警告，若兩股壓力同步加劇，可能成為美股近 4 年多頭行情的重大威脅。
美國財政部週三宣布，將回購 60 億美元長期美國公債，規模高於先前規劃的 20 億美元，也是貝森特 8 月中旬提出擴大回購計畫後，首度提高操作金額。然而，華爾街交易員原先預期回購規模可能介於 60 億至 80 億美元，加上財政部未進一步說明後續安排，市場反應仍顯失望。
消息公布後，美國 10 年期公債殖利率升至 4.836%，創 2023 年 10 月以來最高；30 年期殖利率則升至 5.285%，逼近上月觸及的 20 年高點 5.30% 以上。債券價格與殖利率呈反向走勢。
貝森特希望透過回購長期公債穩定市場並抑制殖利率，但實際結果卻推高美國政府及企業的借貸成本。Mackenzie Investments 首席固定收益策略師 Dustin Reid 表示，目前仍處於觀察財政部如何管理市場的初期階段，但財政部顯然不會樂見市場對回購計畫的反應。
殖利率上升不僅提高美債相對於股票的吸引力，也可能壓縮企業估值並推升融資成本，尤其不利於正透過大規模舉債、投入 AI 資料中心建設的超大規模雲端服務商。
日元升值威脅套利交易
美股面臨的另一項風險來自日元走強。美日近期聯手干預匯市後，日元對美元持續升值；日本央行又可能於下週升息，進一步強化日元漲勢。
日元過去長期是全球成本最低的融資貨幣之一。投資人通常借入低利率日元，兌換成美元後投入美國科技股等高報酬資產，形成所謂「日元套利交易」。
一旦日元快速升值，投資人償還日元貸款的成本將增加，可能被迫出售美國股票並回補日元。Interactive Brokers 首席策略師 Steve Sosnick表示，日元漲勢已累積足夠動能，可能迫使部分借入日元、槓桿押注高漲美股的投資人退場。
GammaRoad Capital Partners 投資長 Jordan Rizzuto直言，美債殖利率攀升與日元走強形成的雙重衝擊，是當前美股多頭行情面臨的最大風險。
日本公布的數據顯示，截至 8 月底，日本持有的外國證券規模減少近 880 億美元。由於日本長期是美國公債的主要持有者之一，若日本近期確實出售美債，可能進一步加重美債市場壓力。
這也使美國政策陷入兩難：日元必須維持足夠強勢，降低日本為籌措干預資金而出售美債的可能性；但若日元升值過快，又可能引發套利交易平倉，衝擊美國科技股及其他風險資產。
油價突破百美元增添壓力
除美債殖利率與日元外，美伊戰事延續也推升市場不安。布蘭特原油價格週三一度突破每桶 100 美元，通膨與利率壓力隨之升溫。
美股週三連續第 3 個交易日收黑，道瓊工業指數下跌逾 400 點、跌幅約 0.8%；S&P 500 指數下跌約 0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數則下滑約 0.6%。
個別因素過去尚未對美股造成持久衝擊，但隨著油價、長期殖利率與日元同步走高，華爾街開始擔憂，多項壓力若共同發酵，可能迫使投資人降低槓桿並撤出高估值股票，使 AI 熱潮支撐的美股多頭面臨更劇烈反轉。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that US Treasury Secretary Yellen’s recent interventions in the US bond and yen markets, intended to lower long-term rates and curb yen depreciation, have unexpectedly produced a combination of rising US‑bond yields and a stronger yen. Market participants warn that if both pressures intensify together, they could pose a major threat to the nearly four‑year US‑stock bull run.

The US Treasury announced on Wednesday that it will repurchase $6 billion of long‑term Treasury securities, a scale higher than the previously planned $2 billion and the first increase since Yellen’s mid‑August expansion of the buy‑back program. Wall Street traders had expected the repurchase size to be between $6 billion and $8 billion, and the Treasury’s lack of detail on further steps left the market disappointed.

After the announcement, the yield on the 10‑year Treasury rose to 4.836%, the highest since October 2023, while the 30‑year yield climbed to 5.285%, edging close to the more‑than‑5.30% peak reached last month. Bond prices move inversely to yields.

Yellen hoped that buying back long‑term Treasuries would stabilize the market and suppress yields, but the move actually pushed up borrowing costs for the US government and corporations. Dustin Reid, chief fixed‑income strategist at Mackenzie Investments, said the market is still in the early observation stage of how the Treasury will manage the market, and the Treasury clearly does not welcome the reaction to the buy‑back plan.

Higher yields not only make US bonds more attractive relative to stocks, they also compress corporate valuations and raise financing costs, a particular disadvantage for mega‑scale cloud providers that are financing massive AI data‑center builds through large‑scale debt issuance.
Yen appreciation threatens carry‑trade arbitrage

Another risk to US equities comes from a stronger yen. After recent coordinated US‑Japan intervention in the foreign‑exchange market, the yen has continued to rise against the dollar, and the Bank of Japan may raise rates next week, further bolstering the yen’s upward momentum.

The yen has long been one of the world’s cheapest financing currencies. Investors typically borrow low‑cost yen, convert it to dollars and invest in high‑return assets such as US tech stocks, creating the so‑called “yen carry‑trade.”

If the yen appreciates rapidly, the cost of repaying yen loans rises, potentially forcing investors to sell US stocks and reconvert into yen. Steve Sosnick, chief strategist at Interactive Brokers, said the yen’s rally has built enough momentum that it could push some leveraged investors who borrowed yen to bet on soaring US stocks out of the market.

Jordan Rizzuto, investment head at GammaRoad Capital Partners, bluntly stated that the dual shock of rising US‑bond yields and a stronger yen is the biggest risk facing the current US‑stock bull market.

Japanese data show that by the end of August, Japan’s holdings of foreign securities fell by nearly $88 billion. As Japan has long been one of the major holders of US Treasuries, any recent sales of US bonds by Japan could further pressure the Treasury market.

This puts US policy in a dilemma: the yen must stay strong enough to reduce Japan’s incentive to sell Treasuries to fund intervention, yet if the yen strengthens too quickly it could trigger carry‑trade unwindings that hit US tech stocks and other risk assets.
Oil prices breaking $100 add pressure
Beyond bond yields and the yen, the ongoing US‑Iran conflict is also heightening market anxiety. Brent crude surged past $100 a barrel on Wednesday, stoking inflation and rate pressures.

US stocks closed lower for the third consecutive trading day on Wednesday, with the Dow down more than 400 points (about 0.8%), the S&P 500 off roughly 0.5% and the Nasdaq Composite slipping about 0.6%.

While individual factors have not yet caused a lasting hit to US equities, the simultaneous rise in oil prices, long‑term yields and the yen is prompting Wall Street to worry that multiple pressures could combine, forcing investors to cut leverage and exit overvalued stocks, potentially delivering a sharper reversal to the AI‑driven US‑stock bull market.

items.title: 1929年大崩盤恐重演！橋水達利歐：我們現在正處於AI泡沫中
items.title_en: 1929 Great Crash May Repeat! Ray Dalio of Bridgewater: We Are Currently in an AI Bubble
paras: 橋水基金創辦人達利歐(Ray Dalio)最新表示，當前AI熱潮與以往歷次科技泡沫遵循相同的歷史模式，「我們現在正處於泡沫中」，並稱危險在於人們無法區分科技本身的奇蹟，以及與之相關的投資。
達利歐週三(9日)在X平台上發文說，幾乎每一輪科技榮景都會催生泡沫並最終破裂，並以鐵路建設熱潮與工業革命作為過往例證。
他提到1920年代末，電力、冷凍技術、電話、無線電、飛機與汽車幾乎在同一時期湧現，這類時代節點自然會吸引大量投資者入場。
他解釋道，一項技術或許確實具備變革性，但若相關股票估值過高，或是透過借貸資金買入，就會引發崩盤，「正是這套機制導致了1929年至1933年的市場暴跌」。
達利歐認為，AI領域如今正上演同樣的態勢，並稱「我們現在正處於泡沫之中」。
他指出，儘管這項技術最終很可能被證明具備價值，但投資者仍需要評估：誰才是真正的受益方、AI能否創造真實收益，以及當前股價是否反映了過度樂觀的情緒。
paras_en: Bridgewater founder Ray Dalio said the current AI frenzy follows the same historical pattern as previous tech bubbles, stating “we are now in a bubble,” and warned that the danger lies in people’s inability to distinguish the miracle of the technology itself from the related investments.

Dalio posted on X on Wednesday (the 9th) that almost every wave of tech optimism eventually spawns a bubble that bursts, citing the railway‑building boom and the Industrial Revolution as past examples.

He noted that at the end of the 1920s electricity, refrigeration, telephones, radio, aircraft and automobiles all emerged almost simultaneously, and such inflection points naturally attract massive investor inflows.

He explained that a technology may indeed be transformative, but if the associated stocks are over‑valued or bought with borrowed money, a crash ensues – “it was exactly this mechanism that caused the market plunge from 1929 to 1933.”
Dalio believes the AI sector is now showing the same dynamics and reiterated, “we are now in a bubble.”

He added that although the technology will likely prove valuable in the long run, investors still need to assess who the real beneficiaries are, whether AI can generate genuine earnings, and whether current stock prices reflect overly optimistic sentiment.

items.title: 蘋果改寫晶片封裝：A20 Pro攜台積電2奈米登場　棄PoP轉WMCM
items.title_en: Apple Rewrites Chip Packaging: A20 Pro Debuts with TSMC 2nm, Ditches PoP for WMCM
paras: 蘋果周三(9日)召開2026秋季發布會，推出iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max與摺疊機iPhone Duo，並更新Apple Watch。相比外觀與影像迭代，最大亮點是晶片革新，A20 Pro登場，首次把2nm製程帶入iPhone，並放棄沿用多年的PoP垂直堆疊封裝。
A20 Pro採用台積電2奈米製程，配備6核CPU(2性能核＋4能效核)，性能核最高提升20%；7核GPU圖形性能最高提升40%，端側AI算力翻倍，記憶體帶寬提升50%。
更值得注意的是，蘋果已不再單純追求CPU性能，而是把更多晶體管投入AI運算；A20 Pro搭載雙16核神經引擎、總計32個神經網絡核心，AI處理能力較A19 Pro提升約2倍，並新增神經網絡加速與FP8計算能力。
手機晶片競爭已從CPU、GPU比拼轉向AI算力競爭：如今要看它能否在本地運行大模型、圖像生成、語音識別與AI智能體任務。
A20 Pro記憶體帶寬提升50%，擁有iPhone史上更寬的記憶體接口。AI運算不同於傳統應用：模型規模愈大，若數據不能快速從記憶體送至計算單元，處理器依然會被「餓住」，因此手機晶片競爭已變成「算力＋記憶體帶寬＋封裝」的綜合競爭，這也直接推動蘋果改變封裝方式。
過去，手機晶片普遍採用PoP封裝，把處理器與DRAM「上下疊放」像蓋樓，優勢是節省空間，但進入2奈米與AI時代，PoP在傳輸距離、信號連接與散熱上壓力日增。
A20 Pro轉向台積電WMCM(Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module，晶圓級多晶片模組)先進封裝，可將CPU、GPU、NPU和DRAM整合到同一封裝，並通過RDL(重佈線層)高速連接。
不同於PoP，WMCM強調橫向協同，把DRAM從處理器頂部移到封裝側面，優化傳輸路徑並改善散熱。傳統PoP走線長、延遲高、帶寬受限，雙層熱源叠加致熱量堆積，且難以擴容NPU；WMCM則讓SoC與DRAM橫向平鋪於同一RDL層，互聯距離縮短、吞吐效率更高，熱源分散、散熱更好並預留空間支撐大算力AI單元。未來，手機晶片競爭不止是2奈米、1.6奈米之爭，還將延伸至先進封裝。
此外，A20 Pro的CPU、GPU與AI算力全面提升，單位面積產熱隨之增加，發熱問題繞不開。蘋果同步擴大iPhone 18 Pro的VC均熱板面積，較上一代增加約3倍，並通過液體循環、石墨、銅材料改善熱傳導，這揭示一個趨勢：先進製程解決「晶片多強」，先進封裝解決「晶片如何連接」，散熱解決「能否長時間高性能」，三者愈發不可分割。
除A20 Pro，蘋果還推出C2基帶與N1無線晶片。C2上傳速度最高提升50%、功耗降約15%，支持美國5G毫米波；N1支持Wi-Fi 7、藍牙6與Thread，減少對第三方依賴。
Apple Watch的S11芯片則採用2個能效核心、單核GPU與4核神經引擎。從A20 Pro負責計算，到C2負責通信、N1負責無線連接，蘋果正把愈來愈多核心晶片納入自研體系。
2奈米製程提升晶體管密度，32核神經引擎強化AI，記憶體帶寬提升50%，新封裝改善數據連接，3倍VC均熱板解決持續性能，C2與N1完善通信，這些共同組成完整行動運算平台。
過去廠商比誰的CPU更快、GPU更強，未來拉開差距的可能是「製程＋架構＋AI＋記憶體＋先進封裝＋散熱＋通信＋軟體」能否形成完整體系。
A20 Pro最大信號不是「第一顆2奈米手機芯片」，而是把競爭推進到系統級。傳統PoP弱化、芯片與記憶體走向協同封裝，將是下一階段手機半導體的重要變化。
paras_en: Apple held its 2026 fall event on Wednesday (the 9th), unveiling the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, the foldable iPhone Duo, and an updated Apple Watch. Beyond cosmetic and camera upgrades, the headline is a chip breakthrough: the A20 Pro, which brings a 2nm process to the iPhone for the first time and abandons the long‑used PoP vertical‑stack packaging.

The A20 Pro is built on TSMC’s 2nm process and features a six‑core CPU (two performance cores and four efficiency cores), with the performance cores up to 20% faster; a seven‑core GPU delivering up to 40% higher graphics performance; edge‑AI compute power doubled; and memory bandwidth increased by 50%.

More noteworthy is that Apple is no longer chasing pure CPU speed; it has poured more transistors into AI computing. The A20 Pro houses dual 16‑core neural engines – 32 neural‑network cores in total – boosting AI processing capability roughly two‑fold versus the A19 Pro and adding neural‑network acceleration and FP8 compute support.

Mobile‑chip competition has shifted from CPU and GPU battles to AI compute power: the key now is whether a chip can run large models, generate images, perform speech recognition and handle AI‑agent tasks locally.

The A20 Pro’s memory bandwidth is up 50%, giving the iPhone its widest memory interface ever. AI workloads differ from traditional apps: the larger the model, the more critical fast data movement from memory to compute units becomes, or the processor will be “starved.” Thus chip competition has become a combined contest of compute, memory bandwidth and packaging, which directly drives Apple’s packaging change.

Historically, mobile chips have used PoP packaging, stacking the processor and DRAM vertically like a building, saving space. In the 2nm and AI era, PoP faces growing pressure on transmission distance, signal routing and heat dissipation.

The A20 Pro moves to TSMC’s WMCM (Wafer‑Level Multi‑Chip Module) advanced packaging, integrating CPU, GPU, NPU and DRAM in a single package and linking them via high‑speed RDL (redistribution layer) interconnects.

Unlike PoP, WMCM emphasizes horizontal collaboration, moving DRAM from the top of the processor to the side of the package, shortening data paths and improving thermal performance. Traditional PoP suffers long routing, high latency, limited bandwidth, stacked heat sources and limited NPU scaling. WMCM lays the SoC and DRAM side‑by‑side on the same RDL layer, reducing interconnect distance, increasing throughput, spreading heat sources and leaving room for larger AI compute units. Future competition will extend beyond 2nm vs. 1.6nm to advanced packaging as well.

In addition, the A20 Pro’s CPU, GPU and AI compute all see substantial gains, raising power density and heat generation. Apple therefore expands the VC heat‑spreader area on the iPhone 18 Pro by about three‑fold compared with the previous generation and employs liquid‑cycle cooling, graphite and copper materials to improve thermal conduction. This reveals a trend: advanced processes solve “how strong the chip can be,” advanced packaging solves “how the chip connects,” and thermal solutions address “whether it can sustain high performance for long periods,” with the three becoming increasingly inseparable.

Besides the A20 Pro, Apple also introduced the C2 modem and the N1 wireless chip. The C2 offers up to a 50% increase in uplink speed, about 15% lower power consumption, and supports U.S. 5G mmWave. The N1 adds Wi‑Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and Thread support, reducing reliance on third‑party solutions.

The Apple Watch’s S11 chip uses two efficiency cores, a single‑core GPU and a four‑core neural engine. From the A20 Pro handling computation, to the C2 managing communications and the N1 handling wireless connectivity, Apple is folding more core components into its in‑house ecosystem.

The 2nm process raises transistor density, the 32‑core neural engine strengthens AI, memory bandwidth is up 50%, the new packaging improves data links, a three‑times larger VC heat spreader solves sustained performance, and the C2 and N1 round out communications – together forming a complete mobile compute platform.

In the past, vendors compared who had the faster CPU or stronger GPU; the next differentiator will be whether the combination of process, architecture, AI, memory, advanced packaging, thermal design, communications and software can form a cohesive system.

The biggest signal from the A20 Pro isn’t that it’s “the first 2nm phone chip,” but that it pushes competition to the system level. The weakening of traditional PoP and the move toward co‑packaged chip‑and‑memory will be a major shift in the next phase of mobile semiconductors.

items.title: 川普砲口再對準台灣晶片 放話祭100%、200%高關稅
items.title_en: Trump Fires Up Threats of 100%–200% Tariffs on Taiwanese Chips
paras: 美國總統川普週三 (9 日) 在達拉斯舉行的共和黨期中選舉大會發表演說時，再度將矛頭指向台灣半導體產業。他批評美國歷屆政府任由晶片製造業外移至台灣，宣稱美方早該對台灣輸美晶片課徵高額關稅，稅率甚至可達 100%或 200%，如此便能阻止產業出走。
川普 9 日在選舉造勢場合中，談到關稅政策及外企對美投資時表示，過去「愚蠢的總統」讓晶片產業離開美國、轉移至台灣。他宣稱，當時只要對進口晶片課徵關稅，相關產業就不會離開，但前幾屆政府沒有這麼做，直到他上任後才開始改變。
他說：「台灣要把晶片賣到美國，就得付100%、200%、50%，隨便多少的關稅。」
川普再次重申「關稅」是自己最喜歡的字詞之一，宣稱關稅不僅能為美國帶來龐大收入，也能吸引外國企業投資，進而把生產線與工作機會帶回美國。
點名英特爾由盛轉衰
談及美國晶片產業發展時，川普以英特爾(INTC-US) 為例，將這家美國晶片大廠一度陷入困境，歸因於美國政府放任半導體產業外移。
川普表示，英特爾原本是一家相當優秀的公司，後來卻逐漸變得「老舊、疲憊」，並陷入經營困境。
當英特爾執行長尋求政府協助時，他要求公司交出10%股權，作為美國政府出手協助的交換條件。
川普稱，英特爾當時市值約1,200億美元，10%持股價值約120億美元，公司負責人當場接受條件。
他還強調，英特爾股價隨後大幅上漲，美國政府持股在數月內創造約500億至600億美元利益，但相關說法並未在演說中提供進一步計算依據。
關稅成期中選舉經濟牌
川普將晶片關稅與共和黨的期中選舉訴求連結，強調其政府正透過關稅、外國投資及企業持股，為美國創造新的收入來源。
他並宣布，若共和黨在11月3日舉行的期中選舉中，同時保住聯邦眾議院與參議院控制權，將向每名美國成年公民發放5,000美元「川普紅利」(Trump Dividend)，但款項只能在美國境內消費。
川普宣稱，這項紅利將來自美國的經濟成果，概念類似企業向股東發放現金。不過，他並未說明計畫所需經費、適用資格及如何取得國會授權。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump again aimed his criticism at Taiwan’s semiconductor industry during a speech at the Republican midterm election rally in Dallas on Wednesday, the 9th. He accused past U.S. administrations of allowing chip manufacturing to shift to Taiwan and claimed the U.S. should have imposed steep tariffs on chips imported from Taiwan—rates as high as 100% or even 200%—to keep the industry at home.

At the rally on the 9th, Trump linked tariff policy and foreign investment to the notion that “stupid presidents” let the chip sector leave the United States for Taiwan. He asserted that simply imposing tariffs on imported chips would have prevented the exodus, but previous administrations failed to act, and only after he took office did the approach change.
He said, “If Taiwan wants to sell chips to the United States, it has to pay 100%, 200%, 50%—any amount of tariff you like.”

Trump reiterated that “tariffs” are one of his favorite words, claiming they would not only generate huge revenue for America but also attract foreign companies to invest and bring production lines and jobs back to the United States.
Naming Intel’s rise and fall

When discussing the U.S. chip industry, Trump used Intel (INTC‑US) as an example, blaming the American chip giant’s troubles on the U.S. government’s permissiveness in allowing semiconductor production to move abroad.
Trump said Intel was once a very strong company but has become “old, tired” and is now struggling operationally.
He claimed that when Intel’s CEO asked for government help, Trump demanded the company hand over a 10% equity stake as a condition for U.S. assistance.
Trump estimated Intel’s market value at about $120 billion at the time, making a 10% stake worth roughly $12 billion, and said the company’s leaders accepted the terms on the spot.

He also emphasized that Intel’s stock subsequently surged, allowing the U.S. government’s share to generate roughly $50 billion to $60 billion in profit within months, though he provided no detailed calculations in the speech.
Tariffs as a midterm election economic card

Trump tied chip tariffs to the Republican Party’s midterm election platform, stressing that his administration was creating new revenue streams for the United States through tariffs, foreign investment, and corporate equity stakes.

He announced that if Republicans retain control of both the House and the Senate in the November 3 midterm election, each adult American citizen will receive a $5,000 “Trump Dividend,” which can only be spent within the United States.

Trump said the dividend would come from America’s economic performance, likening it to a corporation paying cash to its shareholders. He did not detail the funding required, eligibility criteria, or how Congress would authorize the program.

items.title: 果粉關心iPhone Duo螢幕有無摺痕 蘋果官方回應了
items.title_en: Apple Fans Wonder If iPhone Duo Screen Has Creases; Apple Officially Responds
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 推出首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo，不僅是蘋果史上螢幕最大、售價最高的手機，螢幕摺痕與機身耐用度也成為果粉關注焦點。蘋果會後回應，Duo透過特殊材料與結構設計，能將螢幕應力及摺痕減至最低。
蘋果表示，iPhone Duo 將既有的 iPhone 使用體驗帶入摺疊設計，並搭配全面重塑的 iOS 27，讓使用者能以不同擺放方式及角度操作，也可進行多工處理，或透過 Siri AI 與 Apple Intelligence 獲得協助。
針對內螢幕摺疊處是否會出現摺痕，蘋果指出，iPhone Duo 採用平整光滑的內螢幕，並加入特製奈米紋理表面處理技術，以減少眩光及反射。
此外，螢幕內部使用光學透明膠，讓各層結構在摺疊時能夠順暢滑動，藉此降低螢幕承受的應力，將摺痕減至最低。不過，蘋果並未宣稱螢幕能完全避免摺痕。
在顯示規格方面，Duo 配備廣視角 OLED 面板，內外螢幕峰值亮度最高均可達 3,000 尼特，並支援 ProMotion 技術，可自動調整更新率，最高達 120Hz，即使在強烈陽光下也能維持清晰度。
耐用性方面，iPhone Duo 配備 5 級鈦金屬邊框與軸承蓋，轉軸在展開及闔起時可維持平順均衡的阻力。機身具備 IP68 防潑抗水與防塵能力，前後均有超瓷晶盾面板保護，內螢幕則加入抗刮鍍膜。
此外，為維持機身厚度，iPhone Duo 在全球市場均僅支援 eSIM。蘋果也表示，Duo 未來將支援 Apple Pencil（USB-C），相關功能預計今年稍晚推出。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has launched its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, which is not only the largest-screen and most expensive device in Apple’s history, but also draws fan attention to screen creases and body durability. Apple responded after the event, saying the Duo’s special materials and structural design minimize screen stress and creases.

Apple says the iPhone Duo brings the existing iPhone user experience into a foldable design, paired with a completely re‑imagined iOS 27, allowing users to operate the device in various orientations and angles, multitask, or get assistance via Siri AI and Apple Intelligence.

Addressing whether the inner screen’s fold will show creases, Apple points out that the iPhone Duo uses a flat, smooth inner display with a specially engineered nano‑texture surface treatment to reduce glare and reflections.

In addition, the screen’s interior employs an optically clear adhesive so that the layers can glide smoothly when folded, thereby lowering the stress on the display and reducing creases to the minimum. However, Apple does not claim the screen can be completely crease‑free.

In terms of display specs, the Duo is equipped with a wide‑viewing‑angle OLED panel; both the inner and outer screens can reach a peak brightness of up to 3,000 nits and support ProMotion technology that automatically adjusts the refresh rate up to 120 Hz, maintaining clarity even in bright sunlight.

For durability, the iPhone Duo features a Grade‑5 titanium frame and bearing caps, with a hinge that provides smooth, balanced resistance when opening and closing. The body has IP68 water‑ and dust‑resistance, front and rear ultra‑ceramic shield panels, and the inner screen includes a scratch‑resistant coating.

To keep the device thin, the iPhone Duo supports eSIM only in all global markets. Apple also said the Duo will eventually support the Apple Pencil (USB‑C), with related functionality expected to roll out later this year.

items.title: 不是收購卻像收購？輝達與Groq授權協議 遭美反壟斷調查
items.title_en: Not an acquisition but looks like one? Nvidia and Groq licensing deal under US antitrust probe
paras: 美國司法部正調查輝達(NVDA-US) 是否刻意設計與人工智慧晶片新創公司 Groq 達成的 200 億美元技術授權協議，以規避反壟斷審查。
彭博引述消息人士報導，監管機構正在審查這筆去年 12 月宣布的交易。輝達透過協議取得 Groq 技術的使用權，Groq 執行長 Jonathan Ross 與營運長 Sunny Madra 也隨交易加入輝達，但 Groq 仍維持獨立公司地位。
美國國會議員其後批評，這筆交易實質上形同收購，並壓抑市場競爭。
輝達代表拒絕評論美國政府是否正在調查其收購 Groq 資產一事；司法部發言人則援例不對未公開案件發表評論。
隨著少數科技巨頭逐步鞏固其在人工智慧產業的主導地位，美國監管機關正加倍嚴格審視「授權兼攬才」的合作模式。亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 及 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google 等企業，被指透過這類交易取得具潛力的技術與工程團隊，同時規避監管審查。
早在 2024 年，美國司法部便開始調查輝達的相關業務，以尋找可能違反反壟斷法的證據。彭博當時報導，司法部已向輝達及其周邊企業索取資料。
消息人士表示，監管機構今年初開始就輝達與 Groq 的交易提出詢問，並將其納入更廣泛的調查。這項授權交易調查最早由《紐約時報》披露，最終也可能在未採取任何行動的情況下結案。
Groq 主要開發用於加速 AI 推論運算的處理器，該公司並未將與輝達簽訂的授權協議提交反壟斷審查。
輝達發言人透過聲明表示，Groq 的案例堪稱美國體制發揮效能的典範，不僅能推動創新、回饋創業家，亦嘉惠終端消費者；相關法律旨在鼓勵美國的新創生態圈，並保障發明家與勞動者追求理想的基本權利。
若司法部最終認定輝達在該交易案中理應尋求反壟斷審查卻未申報，恐將面臨民事裁罰。
paras_en: The U.S. Department of Justice is investigating whether Nvidia (NVDA-US) deliberately structured a $20 billion technology licensing agreement with AI chip startup Groq to evade antitrust review.

Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that regulators are scrutinizing the deal announced in December last year. Under the agreement Nvidia obtained rights to use Groq’s technology, and Groq CEO Jonathan Ross and COO Sunny Madra joined Nvidia as part of the transaction, though Groq remains an independent company.
Congressional members later criticized the deal as effectively a takeover that suppresses market competition.
Nvidia representatives declined to comment on whether the U.S. government is probing its acquisition of Groq assets; a DOJ spokesperson said they do not comment on ongoing investigations.

As a handful of tech giants gradually cement their dominance in the AI industry, U.S. regulators are tightening scrutiny of “license‑and‑talent‑acquisition” collaborations. Companies such as Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US) and Alphabet’s Google (GOOGL-US) are accused of using such deals to acquire promising technology and engineering teams while sidestepping regulatory review.

Back in 2024, the DOJ began probing Nvidia’s related business activities for possible antitrust violations. Bloomberg reported that the department had already requested information from Nvidia and its affiliates at that time.

Sources said regulators started questioning Nvidia’s transaction with Groq earlier this year and have folded it into a broader investigation. The licensing deal was first disclosed by The New York Times and may ultimately be closed without any enforcement action.
Groq, which builds processors to accelerate AI inference workloads, did not submit the licensing agreement with Nvidia for antitrust clearance.

A Nvidia spokesperson said the Groq case exemplifies how the U.S. system can work efficiently, fostering innovation, rewarding entrepreneurs and benefiting end‑users; the relevant laws are meant to encourage the American startup ecosystem and protect inventors’ and workers’ fundamental rights to pursue their ambitions.
If the DOJ ultimately determines that Nvidia should have sought antitrust clearance for the transaction but failed to do so, the company could face civil penalties.

items.title: 台積電8月營收首度衝破5字頭 達5,148億元再攀峰
items.title_en: TSMC August Revenue Breaks 5‑Trillion NTD Mark, Reaches NT$5,148.6 Billion
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)今(10)日公佈 8 月營收新台幣 5,148 億 600 萬元，月增 10.1%，年增 53.3%，累計前 8 月營收為新台幣 3 兆 3,868 億 7,000 萬元，年增 39.3%；受惠AI晶片需求強勁，3、5奈米與先進封裝產能全開，加上2奈米逐步拉升，帶動台積電8月營收再創新高，並首度衝破5,000億元大關。
台積電預估，第三季營收 446-458 億美元，以美元兌新台幣 32 為基礎計算，折合新台幣營收達 1 兆 4,272 億元至 1 兆 4,656 億元，以7、8月營收合計來看，已達高標的67%。
台積電目前正積極加速先進製程建置，中科二期基地預計規劃四座1.4奈米新廠，建置進度超前約半年，首座廠房(P1)可望在明年4月完工啟動試機，屆時將進一步拉大與競爭對手的差距。
此外，台積電攜手艾斯摩爾(ASML)推進12吋光罩，將進一步增加產出效率，預計將在2030年導入量產階段，並在2031年建立試產線，搶攻先進製程，可望進一步強化台積電在技術的領導地位。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US) announced today (Oct 10) that its August revenue was NT$5,148.6 billion, up 10.1% month‑on‑month and 53.3% year‑on‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months was NT$3.38687 trillion, a 39.3% annual increase. Strong AI‑chip demand, full‑capacity operation of 3‑nm, 5‑nm and advanced packaging, and the gradual ramp‑up of 2‑nm drove August revenue to a new high, breaking the NT$5‑trillion threshold for the first time.

TSMC forecasts third‑quarter revenue of $44.6‑$45.8 billion. Using an exchange rate of NT$32 per US$, this translates to NT$1.4272‑1.4656 trillion. Combined revenue for July and August already reaches 67% of the upper end of that range.

TSMC is actively accelerating its advanced‑process build‑out. The second phase of its Central Taiwan Science Park site plans four 1.4‑nm fabs, with construction about six months ahead of schedule. The first fab (P1) is expected to be completed and start trial runs in April 2025, further widening the gap with rivals.

In addition, TSMC is partnering with ASML to advance 12‑inch photomasks, which will boost production efficiency. The technology is slated for mass‑production introduction in 2030 and a pilot line in 2031, targeting advanced nodes and strengthening TSMC’s technological leadership.

items.title: 出貨上看3500萬支！高盛：iPhone Duo定價「實惠」　鴻海、南亞與大立光等大中華區供應商受惠
paras: 蘋果首款摺疊iPhone正式亮相，高盛認為其定價策略與產品設計均超出預期，有望打開大眾市場，並對大中華區供應鏈構成顯著利多。
高盛大中華科技團隊今(10)日發布最新研報指出，蘋果摺疊機iPhone Duo，要價1999美元起跳，低於三星Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra在美國的2099.99美元。分析師Allen Chang、Verena Jeng等人將此定價描述為「Affordable」(實惠)，認為蘋果在記憶體成本高企與強規格配置的制約下，仍實現具競爭力的定價，有望吸引更廣泛消費群體。

iPhone Duo摺疊後5.4吋、展開7.6吋，可單手握持、放入口袋，定位「史上最薄iPhone」。高盛認為，這讓該設備相較現有摺疊產品更易攜帶、更易普及。
規格上，iPhone Duo搭載逾100個精密組件的鉸鏈系統、螢幕下前置鏡頭與新一代均熱板散熱模組，並支持Apple Pencil。

iPhone 18 Pro及Pro Max搭載A20 Pro晶片，並深度整合Apple Intelligence，對散熱管理要求更高，新一代均熱板對AVC、AAC等供應商構成積極信號。此外，該系列售價較iPhone 17 Pro上調約100美元，交貨周期與上代持平。
相機方面，後置鏡頭引入可變光圈技術，光圈可隨焦距動態調整，有利弱光拍攝與更自然虛化，高盛特別提及大立光受惠。

items.title: 貝森特恐成美股牛市最大敵人！日元、美債夾擊多頭
items.title_en: Biden May Become the Biggest Threat to the US Stock Bull Market: Yen and US Bonds Squeeze Bulls
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，美國財長貝森特近期分別介入美債與日元市場，原意是壓低長期利率並阻止日元持續貶值，卻意外形成「美債殖利率走高、日元升值」的組合。市場人士警告，若兩股壓力同步加劇，可能成為美股近 4 年多頭行情的重大威脅。
美國財政部週三宣布，將回購 60 億美元長期美國公債，規模高於先前規劃的 20 億美元，也是貝森特 8 月中旬提出擴大回購計畫後，首度提高操作金額。然而，華爾街交易員原先預期回購規模可能介於 60 億至 80 億美元，加上財政部未進一步說明後續安排，市場反應仍顯失望。
消息公布後，美國 10 年期公債殖利率升至 4.836%，創 2023 年 10 月以來最高；30 年期殖利率則升至 5.285%，逼近上月觸及的 20 年高點 5.30% 以上。債券價格與殖利率呈反向走勢。
貝森特希望透過回購長期公債穩定市場並抑制殖利率，但實際結果卻推高美國政府及企業的借貸成本。Mackenzie Investments 首席固定收益策略師 Dustin Reid 表示，目前仍處於觀察財政部如何管理市場的初期階段，但財政部顯然不會樂見市場對回購計畫的反應。
殖利率上升不僅提高美債相對於股票的吸引力，也可能壓縮企業估值並推升融資成本，尤其不利於正透過大規模舉債、投入 AI 資料中心建設的超大規模雲端服務商。
日元升值威脅套利交易
美股面臨的另一項風險來自日元走強。美日近期聯手干預匯市後，日元對美元持續升值；日本央行又可能於下週升息，進一步強化日元漲勢。
日元過去長期是全球成本最低的融資貨幣之一。投資人通常借入低利率日元，兌換成美元後投入美國科技股等高報酬資產，形成所謂「日元套利交易」。
一旦日元快速升值，投資人償還日元貸款的成本將增加，可能被迫出售美國股票並回補日元。Interactive Brokers 首席策略師 Steve Sosnick表示，日元漲勢已累積足夠動能，可能迫使部分借入日元、槓桿押注高漲美股的投資人退場。
GammaRoad Capital Partners 投資長 Jordan Rizzuto直言，美債殖利率攀升與日元走強形成的雙重衝擊，是當前美股多頭行情面臨的最大風險。
日本公布的數據顯示，截至 8 月底，日本持有的外國證券規模減少近 880 億美元。由於日本長期是美國公債的主要持有者之一，若日本近期確實出售美債，可能進一步加重美債市場壓力。
這也使美國政策陷入兩難：日元必須維持足夠強勢，降低日本為籌措干預資金而出售美債的可能性；但若日元升值過快，又可能引發套利交易平倉，衝擊美國科技股及其他風險資產。
油價突破百美元增添壓力
除美債殖利率與日元外，美伊戰事延續也推升市場不安。布蘭特原油價格週三一度突破每桶 100 美元，通膨與利率壓力隨之升溫。
美股週三連續第 3 個交易日收黑，道瓊工業指數下跌逾 400 點、跌幅約 0.8%；S&P 500 指數下跌約 0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數則下滑約 0.6%。
個別因素過去尚未對美股造成持久衝擊，但隨著油價、長期殖利率與日元同步走高，華爾街開始擔憂，多項壓力若共同發酵，可能迫使投資人降低槓桿並撤出高估值股票，使 AI 熱潮支撐的美股多頭面臨更劇烈反轉。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that US Treasury Secretary Yellen’s recent interventions in the US bond and yen markets, intended to lower long-term rates and curb yen depreciation, have unexpectedly produced a combination of rising US‑bond yields and a stronger yen. Market participants warn that if both pressures intensify together, they could pose a major threat to the nearly four‑year US‑stock bull run.

The US Treasury announced on Wednesday that it will repurchase $6 billion of long‑term Treasury securities, a scale higher than the previously planned $2 billion and the first increase since Yellen’s mid‑August expansion of the buy‑back program. Wall Street traders had expected the repurchase size to be between $6 billion and $8 billion, and the Treasury’s lack of detail on further steps left the market disappointed.

After the announcement, the yield on the 10‑year Treasury rose to 4.836%, the highest since October 2023, while the 30‑year yield climbed to 5.285%, edging close to the more‑than‑5.30% peak reached last month. Bond prices move inversely to yields.

Yellen hoped that buying back long‑term Treasuries would stabilize the market and suppress yields, but the move actually pushed up borrowing costs for the US government and corporations. Dustin Reid, chief fixed‑income strategist at Mackenzie Investments, said the market is still in the early observation stage of how the Treasury will manage the market, and the Treasury clearly does not welcome the reaction to the buy‑back plan.

Higher yields not only make US bonds more attractive relative to stocks, they also compress corporate valuations and raise financing costs, a particular disadvantage for mega‑scale cloud providers that are financing massive AI data‑center builds through large‑scale debt issuance.
Yen appreciation threatens carry‑trade arbitrage

Another risk to US equities comes from a stronger yen. After recent coordinated US‑Japan intervention in the foreign‑exchange market, the yen has continued to rise against the dollar, and the Bank of Japan may raise rates next week, further bolstering the yen’s upward momentum.

The yen has long been one of the world’s cheapest financing currencies. Investors typically borrow low‑cost yen, convert it to dollars and invest in high‑return assets such as US tech stocks, creating the so‑called “yen carry‑trade.”

If the yen appreciates rapidly, the cost of repaying yen loans rises, potentially forcing investors to sell US stocks and reconvert into yen. Steve Sosnick, chief strategist at Interactive Brokers, said the yen’s rally has built enough momentum that it could push some leveraged investors who borrowed yen to bet on soaring US stocks out of the market.

Jordan Rizzuto, investment head at GammaRoad Capital Partners, bluntly stated that the dual shock of rising US‑bond yields and a stronger yen is the biggest risk facing the current US‑stock bull market.

Japanese data show that by the end of August, Japan’s holdings of foreign securities fell by nearly $88 billion. As Japan has long been one of the major holders of US Treasuries, any recent sales of US bonds by Japan could further pressure the Treasury market.

This puts US policy in a dilemma: the yen must stay strong enough to reduce Japan’s incentive to sell Treasuries to fund intervention, yet if the yen strengthens too quickly it could trigger carry‑trade unwindings that hit US tech stocks and other risk assets.
Oil prices breaking $100 add pressure
Beyond bond yields and the yen, the ongoing US‑Iran conflict is also heightening market anxiety. Brent crude surged past $100 a barrel on Wednesday, stoking inflation and rate pressures.

US stocks closed lower for the third consecutive trading day on Wednesday, with the Dow down more than 400 points (about 0.8%), the S&P 500 off roughly 0.5% and the Nasdaq Composite slipping about 0.6%.

While individual factors have not yet caused a lasting hit to US equities, the simultaneous rise in oil prices, long‑term yields and the yen is prompting Wall Street to worry that multiple pressures could combine, forcing investors to cut leverage and exit overvalued stocks, potentially delivering a sharper reversal to the AI‑driven US‑stock bull market.

items.title: 〈港股盤後〉恒指四連跌 失守25000點大關 創六周新低
items.title_en: Hong Kong Stocks After Hours: Hang Seng Index Falls for Fourth Straight Day, Slipping Below 25,000 and Hits Six‑Week Low
paras: 香港股市三大指數周四(10日)連續第4個交易日走弱，跌至6周低點，科網股為領跌族群，主要係因美伊衝突不斷升溫，加上飆漲中的國際油價對投資人情緒造成影響。截至收盤，恒生指數(HSI) 收跌1.27%至24954.47點，恒生科技指數(HSTECH) 收低2.04%至4330.49點，國企指數收黑1.13%至8274.78點。
盤面上，應用軟體、電力設備、重型機械、半導體設備股震盪回檔，藥品、豬肉走勢疲軟，汽車、茶飲、線上零售連跌數日，智譜跌近10.5%，MiniMax亦挫近9%，蔚來跌4.5%，美團跌3.9%。
上漲族群方面，印刷包裝、支付概念股領漲，公共運輸、內銀股、中資券商、家電股震盪上揚，民生銀行漲超3%。
消息面上，美國與伊朗在荷姆茲海峽周邊的軍事對峙未見緩和，市場對中東原油供應中斷的擔憂持續升溫。國際航運數據顯示，荷姆茲海峽商業船舶通行量驟降至5月以來最低水平。受地緣緊張局勢驅動，布蘭特原油周三(9日)一度漲高4%至每桶101.84美元，西德州原油(WTI)結算價格亦漲至96.61美元，創下大約三個半月新高。
大聖資產管理基金經理李明德表示，港股成交持續萎縮，反映市場缺乏方向。他指出，外資近期把港股當作「提款機」套現，資金持續流出。短線而言，若恒指大盤未能重返25200點之上，後市恐進一步下探24600點水位，投資者宜審慎觀望。
paras_en: Hong Kong’s three major stock indices weakened for the fourth consecutive trading day on Thursday (the 10th), sinking to six‑week lows, with technology stocks leading the decline. The drop was mainly driven by the escalating US‑Iran conflict and soaring international oil prices, which dampened investor sentiment. By market close, the Hang Seng Index (HSI) fell 1.27% to 24,954.47 points, the Hang Seng Tech Index (HSTECH) slid 2.04% to 4,330.49 points, and the China Enterprises Index dropped 1.13% to 8,274.78 points.

On the market, application software, power equipment, heavy machinery, and semiconductor equipment stocks retraced amid volatility, while pharmaceuticals and pork prices weakened. Automobile, tea‑drink, and online retail stocks fell for several days in a row, with ZhiPu down nearly 10.5%, MiniMax down about 9%, Nio down 4.5%, and Meituan down 3.9%.

Among the gainers, printing and packaging as well as payment‑related stocks led the rally, while public transport, domestic banks, Chinese brokerage firms, and home‑appliance stocks edged higher, with Minsheng Bank rising over 3%.

On the news side, the military standoff between the United States and Iran around the Hormuz Strait showed no signs of easing, keeping worries about Middle‑East oil supply disruptions high. International shipping data showed commercial vessel traffic through the Strait of Hormuz fell to its lowest level since May. Driven by geopolitical tension, Brent crude surged 4% on Wednesday (the 9th) to $101.84 per barrel, and West Texas Intermediate settled at $96.61, hitting a roughly three‑and‑a‑half‑month high.

Da Sheng Asset Management fund manager Li Mingde said Hong Kong stock trading volume continues to shrink, reflecting a lack of market direction. He noted that foreign investors have recently treated Hong Kong stocks as a “cash‑cow” to cash out, leading to ongoing outflows. In the short term, if the Hang Seng Index fails to climb back above 25,200 points, it could dip further to the 24,600 level, so investors should adopt a cautious wait‑and‑see stance.

items.title: 1929年大崩盤恐重演！橋水達利歐：我們現在正處於AI泡沫中
items.title_en: 1929 Great Crash May Repeat! Ray Dalio of Bridgewater: We Are Currently in an AI Bubble
paras: 橋水基金創辦人達利歐(Ray Dalio)最新表示，當前AI熱潮與以往歷次科技泡沫遵循相同的歷史模式，「我們現在正處於泡沫中」，並稱危險在於人們無法區分科技本身的奇蹟，以及與之相關的投資。
達利歐週三(9日)在X平台上發文說，幾乎每一輪科技榮景都會催生泡沫並最終破裂，並以鐵路建設熱潮與工業革命作為過往例證。
他提到1920年代末，電力、冷凍技術、電話、無線電、飛機與汽車幾乎在同一時期湧現，這類時代節點自然會吸引大量投資者入場。
他解釋道，一項技術或許確實具備變革性，但若相關股票估值過高，或是透過借貸資金買入，就會引發崩盤，「正是這套機制導致了1929年至1933年的市場暴跌」。
達利歐認為，AI領域如今正上演同樣的態勢，並稱「我們現在正處於泡沫之中」。
他指出，儘管這項技術最終很可能被證明具備價值，但投資者仍需要評估：誰才是真正的受益方、AI能否創造真實收益，以及當前股價是否反映了過度樂觀的情緒。
paras_en: Bridgewater founder Ray Dalio said the current AI frenzy follows the same historical pattern as previous tech bubbles, stating “we are now in a bubble,” and warned that the danger lies in people’s inability to distinguish the miracle of the technology itself from the related investments.

Dalio posted on X on Wednesday (the 9th) that almost every wave of tech optimism eventually spawns a bubble that bursts, citing the railway‑building boom and the Industrial Revolution as past examples.

He noted that at the end of the 1920s electricity, refrigeration, telephones, radio, aircraft and automobiles all emerged almost simultaneously, and such inflection points naturally attract massive investor inflows.

He explained that a technology may indeed be transformative, but if the associated stocks are over‑valued or bought with borrowed money, a crash ensues – “it was exactly this mechanism that caused the market plunge from 1929 to 1933.”
Dalio believes the AI sector is now showing the same dynamics and reiterated, “we are now in a bubble.”

He added that although the technology will likely prove valuable in the long run, investors still need to assess who the real beneficiaries are, whether AI can generate genuine earnings, and whether current stock prices reflect overly optimistic sentiment.

items.title: 全球債市震央在日本！殖利率升破3% 恐引爆股災、澆息AI投資
items.title_en: Global Bond Market Shock Centered in Japan! Yields Break 3% Amid Fears of Stock Crash and AI Investment Drought
paras: 日本公債殖利率30年來首度突破3%，野村研究所警告，這波全球長天期利率上揚的源頭，可能正是日本，而非海外市場。
隨著日本財政風險升高，加上貨幣政策正常化預期增強，壓力正透過債券市場向外蔓延，不僅威脅全球股市，更可能衝擊科技股、AI投資及實體經濟。
10年期日本公債殖利率在東京市場盤中一度突破3%，為1996年9月以來首見。
野村研究所執行經濟學家木內登英指出，過去一年日本10年期公債殖利率累計上升約1.4個百分點，漲幅約為同期美國10年期公債殖利率的兩倍，顯示這波日債殖利率上揚主要由日本國內因素驅動，並非受到海外市場牽動。
從絕對水準來看，日債殖利率已創30年新高，美債則僅回到2025年1月以來高點；德國10年期公債殖利率升至2011年以來最高，英國同年期公債殖利率也寫下2008年以來新高。
綜合比較，日本更可能是推升全球長天期利率的源頭，而非被動跟隨其他市場。
三股力量推升日債殖利率
野村研究所指出，日債殖利率突破3%，背後有三項主要因素。
首先，聯準會主席華許近期在傑克森霍爾年會上的談話，強化市場對聯準會9月升息的預期，帶動全球債市承壓。其次，市場普遍預期日本央行也將在9月貨幣政策會議升息，進一步推高日債殖利率。
第三項因素則是日本財政擴張風險加劇。截至8月底，日本各省廳提出的2027年度一般會計預算申請總額，較2026年度預算增加約20兆日圓，引發市場對財政持續惡化的憂慮。
野村研究所分解過去一年日債殖利率上升1.4個百分點的原因後發現，通膨預期升高貢獻約0.49個百分點，日本央行持有日債比率變化及美債殖利率上揚各貢獻約0.08個百分點，實際政策利率預期變化則貢獻約0.15個百分點。
其餘因素合計貢獻0.60個百分點，主要反映日本財政惡化所帶來的風險溢價，也是最大單一推力。
美國罕見介入日本政策
木內登英表示，若長天期利率上揚源自經濟成長潛力改善或通膨預期升高，實質利率未必同步攀升，對經濟的負面影響相對有限；但若主要原因是財政風險，通常會對經濟活動造成實質衝擊，而且影響比短期利率上揚更為遲緩，也更不易被察覺。
面對風險升高，川普政府已罕見介入日本經濟政策。美國財政部長貝森特近期在二十國集團（G20）財長及央行總裁會議上，向日本財務大臣片山皋月及日本央行總裁植田和男表示，日本必須清楚說明財政永續路徑與升息計畫。
野村研究所認為，日圓持續貶值及日債價格下跌，可能對美國乃至全球市場造成負面影響，因此華府正敦促日本央行升息，並要求高市政府收斂財政擴張立場。若日本政府逐步調整積極財政政策，財政惡化風險降低，日債殖利率的上行壓力也可望減輕。
全球股市與AI投資受威脅
野村研究所警告，以日本為震源的全球長天期利率上揚，可能推高各國政府利息支出，形成「財政惡化、殖利率上升」的負向循環；同時也會壓低金融機構持有債券的市場價值，動搖資產負債表穩定性，並壓抑房地產及股票等風險資產價格。
科技與AI相關股票尤其容易受到利率上升衝擊。若全球長天期利率持續走高，可能使股市AI熱潮降溫。AI類股下跌後，相關企業透過股權或債務融資籌措巨額資金的能力也會受限，進而拖慢AI基礎設施投資。
報告指出，最終結果可能不只是全球經濟活動逐步降溫，甚至可能引發突然性的經濟減速。這也說明川普政府為何採取罕見的直接介入行動，要求日本遠離可能進一步壓低日圓、推升長天期殖利率的政策路徑。
paras_en: Japanese government bond yields have broken the 3% mark for the first time in 30 years, and Nomura Research Institute warns that this surge in long‑term global rates may be driven by Japan rather than overseas markets.

As Japan's fiscal risk rises and expectations of monetary policy normalization strengthen, pressure is spilling over from the bond market to the wider economy, threatening global equities and potentially hitting tech stocks, AI investments, and the real economy.
The 10‑year Japanese government bond yield briefly topped 3% during intraday trading in Tokyo, a level not seen since September 1996.

Nomura senior economist Kiuchi Tōei noted that over the past year the 10‑year Japanese bond yield has risen about 1.4 percentage points, roughly twice the increase of the comparable U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield, indicating that the rise is driven mainly by domestic Japanese factors rather than foreign market forces.

In absolute terms, Japanese yields have hit a 30‑year high, while U.S. Treasury yields have only returned to their peak since January 2025; Germany’s 10‑year yield has risen to its highest since 2011, and the UK’s comparable yield has reached a new high not seen since 2008.
Overall, the comparison suggests Japan is more likely the source pushing up global long‑term rates rather than merely following other markets.
Three forces driving Japanese bond yields
Nomura Research Institute identifies three main factors behind the Japanese yield breaking the 3% threshold.

First, recent comments by Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell at the Jackson Hole symposium have reinforced market expectations of a September rate hike in the U.S., putting pressure on global bond markets. Second, markets broadly anticipate that the Bank of Japan will also raise rates at its September policy meeting, further lifting Japanese yields.

The third factor is the heightened risk of Japan’s fiscal expansion. By the end of August, the total budget request for fiscal year 2027 submitted by various ministries had risen by about ¥20 trillion compared with the 2026 budget, sparking concerns over continued fiscal deterioration.

After breaking down the 1.4‑percentage‑point rise in Japanese yields over the past year, Nomura found that higher inflation expectations contributed about 0.49 points, changes in the Bank of Japan’s holdings of JGBs and the rise in U.S. Treasury yields each added roughly 0.08 points, and expected changes in policy rates contributed about 0.15 points.
Other factors together added 0.60 points, mainly reflecting a risk premium from Japan’s worsening fiscal position, which is the single largest driver.
Rare U.S. intervention in Japanese policy

Kiuchi explains that if long‑term rate increases stem from improved growth potential or higher inflation expectations, real rates may not rise in tandem and the negative impact on the economy would be limited; however, if the primary cause is fiscal risk, it typically delivers a real shock to economic activity, with effects that are slower to appear and harder to detect than those from short‑term rate hikes.

Facing heightened risk, the Trump administration has unusually stepped into Japanese economic policy. Treasury Secretary Yellen recently told Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki and Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda at a G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting that Japan must clearly outline a sustainable fiscal path and its rate‑hiking plan.

Nomura believes that the continued depreciation of the yen and falling Japanese bond prices could have adverse effects on the United States and global markets, prompting Washington to urge the BOJ to raise rates and to press the Japanese government to curb its expansionary fiscal stance. If Japan gradually adjusts its aggressive fiscal policy, the risk of fiscal deterioration will lessen and upward pressure on JGB yields should ease.
Global equities and AI investments under threat

Nomura warns that a Japan‑originated rise in global long‑term rates could increase sovereign interest costs worldwide, creating a vicious cycle of “fiscal deterioration and rising yields.” It would also depress the market value of bonds held by financial institutions, destabilize balance sheets, and suppress prices of risk assets such as real estate and stocks.

Technology and AI‑related stocks are especially vulnerable to higher rates. If global long‑term rates stay elevated, the AI‑driven stock market rally could cool. A drop in AI equities would also limit companies’ ability to raise large sums of capital through equity or debt, slowing investment in AI infrastructure.

The report notes that the ultimate outcome may be more than a gradual cooling of global economic activity; it could trigger a sudden slowdown. This helps explain why the Trump administration has taken the rare step of direct intervention, urging Japan to avoid policies that could further weaken the yen and push long‑term yields higher.

items.title: 蘋果改寫晶片封裝：A20 Pro攜台積電2奈米登場　棄PoP轉WMCM
items.title_en: Apple Rewrites Chip Packaging: A20 Pro Debuts with TSMC 2nm, Ditches PoP for WMCM
paras: 蘋果周三(9日)召開2026秋季發布會，推出iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max與摺疊機iPhone Duo，並更新Apple Watch。相比外觀與影像迭代，最大亮點是晶片革新，A20 Pro登場，首次把2nm製程帶入iPhone，並放棄沿用多年的PoP垂直堆疊封裝。
A20 Pro採用台積電2奈米製程，配備6核CPU(2性能核＋4能效核)，性能核最高提升20%；7核GPU圖形性能最高提升40%，端側AI算力翻倍，記憶體帶寬提升50%。
更值得注意的是，蘋果已不再單純追求CPU性能，而是把更多晶體管投入AI運算；A20 Pro搭載雙16核神經引擎、總計32個神經網絡核心，AI處理能力較A19 Pro提升約2倍，並新增神經網絡加速與FP8計算能力。
手機晶片競爭已從CPU、GPU比拼轉向AI算力競爭：如今要看它能否在本地運行大模型、圖像生成、語音識別與AI智能體任務。
A20 Pro記憶體帶寬提升50%，擁有iPhone史上更寬的記憶體接口。AI運算不同於傳統應用：模型規模愈大，若數據不能快速從記憶體送至計算單元，處理器依然會被「餓住」，因此手機晶片競爭已變成「算力＋記憶體帶寬＋封裝」的綜合競爭，這也直接推動蘋果改變封裝方式。
過去，手機晶片普遍採用PoP封裝，把處理器與DRAM「上下疊放」像蓋樓，優勢是節省空間，但進入2奈米與AI時代，PoP在傳輸距離、信號連接與散熱上壓力日增。
A20 Pro轉向台積電WMCM(Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module，晶圓級多晶片模組)先進封裝，可將CPU、GPU、NPU和DRAM整合到同一封裝，並通過RDL(重佈線層)高速連接。
不同於PoP，WMCM強調橫向協同，把DRAM從處理器頂部移到封裝側面，優化傳輸路徑並改善散熱。傳統PoP走線長、延遲高、帶寬受限，雙層熱源叠加致熱量堆積，且難以擴容NPU；WMCM則讓SoC與DRAM橫向平鋪於同一RDL層，互聯距離縮短、吞吐效率更高，熱源分散、散熱更好並預留空間支撐大算力AI單元。未來，手機晶片競爭不止是2奈米、1.6奈米之爭，還將延伸至先進封裝。
此外，A20 Pro的CPU、GPU與AI算力全面提升，單位面積產熱隨之增加，發熱問題繞不開。蘋果同步擴大iPhone 18 Pro的VC均熱板面積，較上一代增加約3倍，並通過液體循環、石墨、銅材料改善熱傳導，這揭示一個趨勢：先進製程解決「晶片多強」，先進封裝解決「晶片如何連接」，散熱解決「能否長時間高性能」，三者愈發不可分割。
除A20 Pro，蘋果還推出C2基帶與N1無線晶片。C2上傳速度最高提升50%、功耗降約15%，支持美國5G毫米波；N1支持Wi-Fi 7、藍牙6與Thread，減少對第三方依賴。
Apple Watch的S11芯片則採用2個能效核心、單核GPU與4核神經引擎。從A20 Pro負責計算，到C2負責通信、N1負責無線連接，蘋果正把愈來愈多核心晶片納入自研體系。
2奈米製程提升晶體管密度，32核神經引擎強化AI，記憶體帶寬提升50%，新封裝改善數據連接，3倍VC均熱板解決持續性能，C2與N1完善通信，這些共同組成完整行動運算平台。
過去廠商比誰的CPU更快、GPU更強，未來拉開差距的可能是「製程＋架構＋AI＋記憶體＋先進封裝＋散熱＋通信＋軟體」能否形成完整體系。
A20 Pro最大信號不是「第一顆2奈米手機芯片」，而是把競爭推進到系統級。傳統PoP弱化、芯片與記憶體走向協同封裝，將是下一階段手機半導體的重要變化。
paras_en: Apple held its 2026 fall event on Wednesday (the 9th), unveiling the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, the foldable iPhone Duo, and an updated Apple Watch. Beyond cosmetic and camera upgrades, the headline is a chip breakthrough: the A20 Pro, which brings a 2nm process to the iPhone for the first time and abandons the long‑used PoP vertical‑stack packaging.

The A20 Pro is built on TSMC’s 2nm process and features a six‑core CPU (two performance cores and four efficiency cores), with the performance cores up to 20% faster; a seven‑core GPU delivering up to 40% higher graphics performance; edge‑AI compute power doubled; and memory bandwidth increased by 50%.

More noteworthy is that Apple is no longer chasing pure CPU speed; it has poured more transistors into AI computing. The A20 Pro houses dual 16‑core neural engines – 32 neural‑network cores in total – boosting AI processing capability roughly two‑fold versus the A19 Pro and adding neural‑network acceleration and FP8 compute support.

Mobile‑chip competition has shifted from CPU and GPU battles to AI compute power: the key now is whether a chip can run large models, generate images, perform speech recognition and handle AI‑agent tasks locally.

The A20 Pro’s memory bandwidth is up 50%, giving the iPhone its widest memory interface ever. AI workloads differ from traditional apps: the larger the model, the more critical fast data movement from memory to compute units becomes, or the processor will be “starved.” Thus chip competition has become a combined contest of compute, memory bandwidth and packaging, which directly drives Apple’s packaging change.

Historically, mobile chips have used PoP packaging, stacking the processor and DRAM vertically like a building, saving space. In the 2nm and AI era, PoP faces growing pressure on transmission distance, signal routing and heat dissipation.

The A20 Pro moves to TSMC’s WMCM (Wafer‑Level Multi‑Chip Module) advanced packaging, integrating CPU, GPU, NPU and DRAM in a single package and linking them via high‑speed RDL (redistribution layer) interconnects.

Unlike PoP, WMCM emphasizes horizontal collaboration, moving DRAM from the top of the processor to the side of the package, shortening data paths and improving thermal performance. Traditional PoP suffers long routing, high latency, limited bandwidth, stacked heat sources and limited NPU scaling. WMCM lays the SoC and DRAM side‑by‑side on the same RDL layer, reducing interconnect distance, increasing throughput, spreading heat sources and leaving room for larger AI compute units. Future competition will extend beyond 2nm vs. 1.6nm to advanced packaging as well.

In addition, the A20 Pro’s CPU, GPU and AI compute all see substantial gains, raising power density and heat generation. Apple therefore expands the VC heat‑spreader area on the iPhone 18 Pro by about three‑fold compared with the previous generation and employs liquid‑cycle cooling, graphite and copper materials to improve thermal conduction. This reveals a trend: advanced processes solve “how strong the chip can be,” advanced packaging solves “how the chip connects,” and thermal solutions address “whether it can sustain high performance for long periods,” with the three becoming increasingly inseparable.

Besides the A20 Pro, Apple also introduced the C2 modem and the N1 wireless chip. The C2 offers up to a 50% increase in uplink speed, about 15% lower power consumption, and supports U.S. 5G mmWave. The N1 adds Wi‑Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and Thread support, reducing reliance on third‑party solutions.

The Apple Watch’s S11 chip uses two efficiency cores, a single‑core GPU and a four‑core neural engine. From the A20 Pro handling computation, to the C2 managing communications and the N1 handling wireless connectivity, Apple is folding more core components into its in‑house ecosystem.

The 2nm process raises transistor density, the 32‑core neural engine strengthens AI, memory bandwidth is up 50%, the new packaging improves data links, a three‑times larger VC heat spreader solves sustained performance, and the C2 and N1 round out communications – together forming a complete mobile compute platform.

In the past, vendors compared who had the faster CPU or stronger GPU; the next differentiator will be whether the combination of process, architecture, AI, memory, advanced packaging, thermal design, communications and software can form a cohesive system.

The biggest signal from the A20 Pro isn’t that it’s “the first 2nm phone chip,” but that it pushes competition to the system level. The weakening of traditional PoP and the move toward co‑packaged chip‑and‑memory will be a major shift in the next phase of mobile semiconductors.

items.title: 川普砲口再對準台灣晶片 放話祭100%、200%高關稅
items.title_en: Trump Fires Up Threats of 100%–200% Tariffs on Taiwanese Chips
paras: 美國總統川普週三 (9 日) 在達拉斯舉行的共和黨期中選舉大會發表演說時，再度將矛頭指向台灣半導體產業。他批評美國歷屆政府任由晶片製造業外移至台灣，宣稱美方早該對台灣輸美晶片課徵高額關稅，稅率甚至可達 100%或 200%，如此便能阻止產業出走。
川普 9 日在選舉造勢場合中，談到關稅政策及外企對美投資時表示，過去「愚蠢的總統」讓晶片產業離開美國、轉移至台灣。他宣稱，當時只要對進口晶片課徵關稅，相關產業就不會離開，但前幾屆政府沒有這麼做，直到他上任後才開始改變。
他說：「台灣要把晶片賣到美國，就得付100%、200%、50%，隨便多少的關稅。」
川普再次重申「關稅」是自己最喜歡的字詞之一，宣稱關稅不僅能為美國帶來龐大收入，也能吸引外國企業投資，進而把生產線與工作機會帶回美國。
點名英特爾由盛轉衰
談及美國晶片產業發展時，川普以英特爾(INTC-US) 為例，將這家美國晶片大廠一度陷入困境，歸因於美國政府放任半導體產業外移。
川普表示，英特爾原本是一家相當優秀的公司，後來卻逐漸變得「老舊、疲憊」，並陷入經營困境。
當英特爾執行長尋求政府協助時，他要求公司交出10%股權，作為美國政府出手協助的交換條件。
川普稱，英特爾當時市值約1,200億美元，10%持股價值約120億美元，公司負責人當場接受條件。
他還強調，英特爾股價隨後大幅上漲，美國政府持股在數月內創造約500億至600億美元利益，但相關說法並未在演說中提供進一步計算依據。
關稅成期中選舉經濟牌
川普將晶片關稅與共和黨的期中選舉訴求連結，強調其政府正透過關稅、外國投資及企業持股，為美國創造新的收入來源。
他並宣布，若共和黨在11月3日舉行的期中選舉中，同時保住聯邦眾議院與參議院控制權，將向每名美國成年公民發放5,000美元「川普紅利」(Trump Dividend)，但款項只能在美國境內消費。
川普宣稱，這項紅利將來自美國的經濟成果，概念類似企業向股東發放現金。不過，他並未說明計畫所需經費、適用資格及如何取得國會授權。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump again aimed his criticism at Taiwan’s semiconductor industry during a speech at the Republican midterm election rally in Dallas on Wednesday, the 9th. He accused past U.S. administrations of allowing chip manufacturing to shift to Taiwan and claimed the U.S. should have imposed steep tariffs on chips imported from Taiwan—rates as high as 100% or even 200%—to keep the industry at home.

At the rally on the 9th, Trump linked tariff policy and foreign investment to the notion that “stupid presidents” let the chip sector leave the United States for Taiwan. He asserted that simply imposing tariffs on imported chips would have prevented the exodus, but previous administrations failed to act, and only after he took office did the approach change.
He said, “If Taiwan wants to sell chips to the United States, it has to pay 100%, 200%, 50%—any amount of tariff you like.”

Trump reiterated that “tariffs” are one of his favorite words, claiming they would not only generate huge revenue for America but also attract foreign companies to invest and bring production lines and jobs back to the United States.
Naming Intel’s rise and fall

When discussing the U.S. chip industry, Trump used Intel (INTC‑US) as an example, blaming the American chip giant’s troubles on the U.S. government’s permissiveness in allowing semiconductor production to move abroad.
Trump said Intel was once a very strong company but has become “old, tired” and is now struggling operationally.
He claimed that when Intel’s CEO asked for government help, Trump demanded the company hand over a 10% equity stake as a condition for U.S. assistance.
Trump estimated Intel’s market value at about $120 billion at the time, making a 10% stake worth roughly $12 billion, and said the company’s leaders accepted the terms on the spot.

He also emphasized that Intel’s stock subsequently surged, allowing the U.S. government’s share to generate roughly $50 billion to $60 billion in profit within months, though he provided no detailed calculations in the speech.
Tariffs as a midterm election economic card

Trump tied chip tariffs to the Republican Party’s midterm election platform, stressing that his administration was creating new revenue streams for the United States through tariffs, foreign investment, and corporate equity stakes.

He announced that if Republicans retain control of both the House and the Senate in the November 3 midterm election, each adult American citizen will receive a $5,000 “Trump Dividend,” which can only be spent within the United States.

Trump said the dividend would come from America’s economic performance, likening it to a corporation paying cash to its shareholders. He did not detail the funding required, eligibility criteria, or how Congress would authorize the program.

items.title: 果粉關心iPhone Duo螢幕有無摺痕 蘋果官方回應了
items.title_en: Apple Fans Wonder If iPhone Duo Screen Has Creases; Apple Officially Responds
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 推出首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo，不僅是蘋果史上螢幕最大、售價最高的手機，螢幕摺痕與機身耐用度也成為果粉關注焦點。蘋果會後回應，Duo透過特殊材料與結構設計，能將螢幕應力及摺痕減至最低。
蘋果表示，iPhone Duo 將既有的 iPhone 使用體驗帶入摺疊設計，並搭配全面重塑的 iOS 27，讓使用者能以不同擺放方式及角度操作，也可進行多工處理，或透過 Siri AI 與 Apple Intelligence 獲得協助。
針對內螢幕摺疊處是否會出現摺痕，蘋果指出，iPhone Duo 採用平整光滑的內螢幕，並加入特製奈米紋理表面處理技術，以減少眩光及反射。
此外，螢幕內部使用光學透明膠，讓各層結構在摺疊時能夠順暢滑動，藉此降低螢幕承受的應力，將摺痕減至最低。不過，蘋果並未宣稱螢幕能完全避免摺痕。
在顯示規格方面，Duo 配備廣視角 OLED 面板，內外螢幕峰值亮度最高均可達 3,000 尼特，並支援 ProMotion 技術，可自動調整更新率，最高達 120Hz，即使在強烈陽光下也能維持清晰度。
耐用性方面，iPhone Duo 配備 5 級鈦金屬邊框與軸承蓋，轉軸在展開及闔起時可維持平順均衡的阻力。機身具備 IP68 防潑抗水與防塵能力，前後均有超瓷晶盾面板保護，內螢幕則加入抗刮鍍膜。
此外，為維持機身厚度，iPhone Duo 在全球市場均僅支援 eSIM。蘋果也表示，Duo 未來將支援 Apple Pencil（USB-C），相關功能預計今年稍晚推出。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has launched its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, which is not only the largest-screen and most expensive device in Apple’s history, but also draws fan attention to screen creases and body durability. Apple responded after the event, saying the Duo’s special materials and structural design minimize screen stress and creases.

Apple says the iPhone Duo brings the existing iPhone user experience into a foldable design, paired with a completely re‑imagined iOS 27, allowing users to operate the device in various orientations and angles, multitask, or get assistance via Siri AI and Apple Intelligence.

Addressing whether the inner screen’s fold will show creases, Apple points out that the iPhone Duo uses a flat, smooth inner display with a specially engineered nano‑texture surface treatment to reduce glare and reflections.

In addition, the screen’s interior employs an optically clear adhesive so that the layers can glide smoothly when folded, thereby lowering the stress on the display and reducing creases to the minimum. However, Apple does not claim the screen can be completely crease‑free.

In terms of display specs, the Duo is equipped with a wide‑viewing‑angle OLED panel; both the inner and outer screens can reach a peak brightness of up to 3,000 nits and support ProMotion technology that automatically adjusts the refresh rate up to 120 Hz, maintaining clarity even in bright sunlight.

For durability, the iPhone Duo features a Grade‑5 titanium frame and bearing caps, with a hinge that provides smooth, balanced resistance when opening and closing. The body has IP68 water‑ and dust‑resistance, front and rear ultra‑ceramic shield panels, and the inner screen includes a scratch‑resistant coating.

To keep the device thin, the iPhone Duo supports eSIM only in all global markets. Apple also said the Duo will eventually support the Apple Pencil (USB‑C), with related functionality expected to roll out later this year.

items.title: 不是收購卻像收購？輝達與Groq授權協議 遭美反壟斷調查
items.title_en: Not an acquisition but looks like one? Nvidia and Groq licensing deal under US antitrust probe
paras: 美國司法部正調查輝達(NVDA-US) 是否刻意設計與人工智慧晶片新創公司 Groq 達成的 200 億美元技術授權協議，以規避反壟斷審查。
彭博引述消息人士報導，監管機構正在審查這筆去年 12 月宣布的交易。輝達透過協議取得 Groq 技術的使用權，Groq 執行長 Jonathan Ross 與營運長 Sunny Madra 也隨交易加入輝達，但 Groq 仍維持獨立公司地位。
美國國會議員其後批評，這筆交易實質上形同收購，並壓抑市場競爭。
輝達代表拒絕評論美國政府是否正在調查其收購 Groq 資產一事；司法部發言人則援例不對未公開案件發表評論。
隨著少數科技巨頭逐步鞏固其在人工智慧產業的主導地位，美國監管機關正加倍嚴格審視「授權兼攬才」的合作模式。亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 及 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google 等企業，被指透過這類交易取得具潛力的技術與工程團隊，同時規避監管審查。
早在 2024 年，美國司法部便開始調查輝達的相關業務，以尋找可能違反反壟斷法的證據。彭博當時報導，司法部已向輝達及其周邊企業索取資料。
消息人士表示，監管機構今年初開始就輝達與 Groq 的交易提出詢問，並將其納入更廣泛的調查。這項授權交易調查最早由《紐約時報》披露，最終也可能在未採取任何行動的情況下結案。
Groq 主要開發用於加速 AI 推論運算的處理器，該公司並未將與輝達簽訂的授權協議提交反壟斷審查。
輝達發言人透過聲明表示，Groq 的案例堪稱美國體制發揮效能的典範，不僅能推動創新、回饋創業家，亦嘉惠終端消費者；相關法律旨在鼓勵美國的新創生態圈，並保障發明家與勞動者追求理想的基本權利。
若司法部最終認定輝達在該交易案中理應尋求反壟斷審查卻未申報，恐將面臨民事裁罰。
paras_en: The U.S. Department of Justice is investigating whether Nvidia (NVDA-US) deliberately structured a $20 billion technology licensing agreement with AI chip startup Groq to evade antitrust review.

Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that regulators are scrutinizing the deal announced in December last year. Under the agreement Nvidia obtained rights to use Groq’s technology, and Groq CEO Jonathan Ross and COO Sunny Madra joined Nvidia as part of the transaction, though Groq remains an independent company.
Congressional members later criticized the deal as effectively a takeover that suppresses market competition.
Nvidia representatives declined to comment on whether the U.S. government is probing its acquisition of Groq assets; a DOJ spokesperson said they do not comment on ongoing investigations.

As a handful of tech giants gradually cement their dominance in the AI industry, U.S. regulators are tightening scrutiny of “license‑and‑talent‑acquisition” collaborations. Companies such as Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US) and Alphabet’s Google (GOOGL-US) are accused of using such deals to acquire promising technology and engineering teams while sidestepping regulatory review.

Back in 2024, the DOJ began probing Nvidia’s related business activities for possible antitrust violations. Bloomberg reported that the department had already requested information from Nvidia and its affiliates at that time.

Sources said regulators started questioning Nvidia’s transaction with Groq earlier this year and have folded it into a broader investigation. The licensing deal was first disclosed by The New York Times and may ultimately be closed without any enforcement action.
Groq, which builds processors to accelerate AI inference workloads, did not submit the licensing agreement with Nvidia for antitrust clearance.

A Nvidia spokesperson said the Groq case exemplifies how the U.S. system can work efficiently, fostering innovation, rewarding entrepreneurs and benefiting end‑users; the relevant laws are meant to encourage the American startup ecosystem and protect inventors’ and workers’ fundamental rights to pursue their ambitions.
If the DOJ ultimately determines that Nvidia should have sought antitrust clearance for the transaction but failed to do so, the company could face civil penalties.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯力道轉強 貶值4.3分收在31.548元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar Buying Pressure Strengthens, Depreciates 4.3 Cents to Close at 31.548
paras: 新台幣今(10)日升貶互見，午盤過後貶勢擴大，終場收在31.548元，貶值4.3分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值放大至19.39億美元。
新台幣今以31.53元、貶值2.5分開出後，雖一度來到31.49元，但隨後買匯力道轉強，午盤後新台幣越走越低，最低來到31.581元，全日高低價差9.1分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元貶值近0.2%，新台幣收貶0.14%，泰銖貶近0.1%，日元和星元貶0.05%左右，人民幣平盤附近波動，而美元指數小跌0.05%，市場瀰漫高度觀望聯準會動態的氣氛。
國泰證期研究部指出，台灣 8 月出口年增 41%，金額創單月新高，AI 需求支撐半導體與伺服器營收展望，惟傳產復甦不均，成本壓力仍須關注，大額貿易順差則有利支撐台幣匯率。
統一投顧則分析，台股基本面支撐力道極強，8 月AI 伺服器供應鏈 8 月營收全數締造新猷，展現強韌獲利動能，緊接著輝達管理層出席高盛科技大會，有望釋出下一階段 AI 需求的樂觀展望，惟地緣政治與油價、債市風暴未歇，短線盤面難免受到牽制。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed mixed movement today (the 10th), with depreciation expanding after the midday session and closing at 31.548, a loss of 4.3 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms saw transaction volume rise to US$1.939 billion.

The NTD opened at 31.53, down 2.5 cents, briefly fell to 31.49, but buying pressure soon strengthened. After the midday session the currency kept sliding, reaching a low of 31.581, with a total intraday range of 9.1 cents.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won weakened by about 0.2%, the NTD fell 0.14%, the Thai baht slipped nearly 0.1%, the Japanese yen and Singapore dollar each lost roughly 0.05%, the Chinese yuan hovered near flat, and the U.S. dollar index slipped 0.05% as markets remained highly cautious about Federal Reserve moves.

Citi Securities’ research team noted that Taiwan’s August exports grew 41% year‑on‑year, hitting a record monthly total. AI demand underpins a positive outlook for semiconductor and server revenues, though recovery in traditional industries is uneven and cost pressures remain a concern. A large trade surplus, however, supports the NTD’s exchange rate.

Unified Investment Advisory analyzed that Taiwan’s equity fundamentals are very strong, with AI‑related server supply‑chain revenues in August all hitting new highs, demonstrating robust profit momentum. Following Nvidia’s management appearance at the Goldman Sachs Technology Conference, optimism about the next phase of AI demand is expected. Nevertheless, geopolitical tensions, oil price volatility, and turmoil in the bond market persist, keeping short‑term market moves constrained.

items.title: 貝森特自稱莊家 對日元與美股意味著什麼？
items.title_en: Biden Claims to Be the House: What It Means for the Yen and US Stocks
paras: 美國財長貝森特向來直言不諱，但他周二晚間在南方衛理公會大學商學院發表的談話，可能是其從政以來態度最強硬的一次。
貝森特談到的，不只是美國財政部近期為支撐日元所採取的干預行動，也包括美方在阿根廷上次大選前，為穩定披索所做的努力。
曾任總體經濟交易員的貝森特表示：「每當有人說，『財長這是在冒險』，我要說，這正是我夢寐以求的局面。我掌握不對稱資訊，現在莊家是我。」
他接著說：「因此，當我們出手干預日元時，我非常清楚日本政府、日本央行及日本決策官員接下來會怎麼做。你想跟我對賭，儘管來。」
到目前為止，美方的外匯干預已取得成效；相較之下，財政部宣布將買進長天期美債後，殖利率僅短暫回落。貝森特介入債市的做法，也遭到其恩師、知名投資人德魯肯米勒（Stanley Druckenmiller）批評。
美日聯手干預前，美元兌日元一度逼近164，目前已回落至約153，最新跌幅約0.32%。
高盛分析師普里沃羅茨基（Rich Privorotsky）在報告中指出，貝森特這番談話帶來的次級效應，才是影響股市的關鍵。市場擔心，隨著日元升值，原本借入低利率日元、再投入其他資產的投資人，將不得不縮減甚至完全平倉，亦即所謂的日元套利交易可能加速退場。
普里沃羅茨基表示：「當以日元融資的套利交易解除，資金回流日本債券與股票時，市場會發生什麼事？」他指出，標普500指數和大型科技股近期在缺乏明顯基本面利空的情況下，走勢卻異常沉重。值得留意的是，部分槓桿與套利部位可能正逐步從市場消退。
瑞銀全球財富管理首席經濟學家唐納文（Paul Donovan）則表示：「只有當日元貶值是由投機因素造成時，賭場的比喻才成立。如果干預前的日元匯價是由基本面驅動，那麼更貼切、儘管較少人熟悉的比喻，應是英國1992年的匯率機制危機。在這種情況下，貝森特應該宣稱：『我就是拉蒙特。』」
拉蒙特（Norman Lamont）當時擔任英國財政大臣，曾試圖讓英國留在歐洲匯率機制內，但最終未能成功。
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Biden is known for speaking bluntly, but his remarks on Tuesday night at the Business School of Southern Methodist University may be the toughest stance he’s taken in his political career.
Biden discussed not only the Treasury’s recent intervention to support the yen, but also US efforts to stabilize the peso before Argentina’s last election.

Former macro trader Biden said, "Whenever someone says, 'The Treasury is taking a risk,' I reply that this is exactly the scenario I’ve dreamed of. I have asymmetric information, and now I am the house."
He added, "So when we intervene in the yen, I know exactly what the Japanese government, the Bank of Japan and Japanese policymakers will do next. If you want to bet against me, go ahead."

So far the US foreign‑exchange intervention has shown results; by contrast, after the Treasury announced it would buy long‑term US bonds, yields only fell briefly. Biden’s move into the bond market was also criticized by his mentor, famed investor Stanley Druckenmiller.
Before the US‑Japan joint intervention, the dollar‑yen rate briefly approached 164, now it has slipped to about 153, a recent decline of roughly 0.32%.

Goldman Sachs analyst Rich Privorotsky noted in a report that the secondary effects of Biden’s comments are the real driver for equities. The market worries that a stronger yen will force investors who borrowed cheap yen to fund other assets to unwind or fully close those positions, accelerating the exit of yen‑carry trades.

Privorotsky said, "When yen‑funded arbitrage unwinds and capital flows back into Japanese bonds and stocks, what will happen to the market?" He pointed out that the S&P 500 and large‑cap tech stocks have been unusually heavy despite a lack of clear fundamental downside, and that some leveraged and arbitrage positions may be gradually disappearing from the market.

UBS Global Wealth Management chief economist Paul Donovan said, "The casino analogy only holds if yen depreciation is driven by speculation. If the pre‑intervention yen rate was fundamentally driven, a more apt, though less familiar, comparison is the 1992 UK exchange‑rate mechanism crisis. In that case, Biden should claim: 'I am Lamont.'"
Norman Lamont was the UK Chancellor at the time who tried to keep Britain in the European Exchange Rate Mechanism but ultimately failed.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Shows Minor Fluctuations, Market Focuses on Central Bank Meetings
paras: 美元周三(9日)變動不大，市場焦點持續落在近期大幅走強的日元。外匯市場參與者正為關鍵的時刻做準備，歐洲央行(ECB)本周將公布利率決議，聯準會(Fed)與日本銀行(BoJ)將於下周公布決策。
美國公債市場同樣受關注，財政部公布備受期待的公債回購操作更新後，規模令投資人失望。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報98.83。
美國財政部宣布將回購60億美元、到期年限10年至20年的美國公債，高於先前的20億美元，消息公布後市場拋售美債，美國公債殖利率大幅上升。
美國財政部上月曾表示，將把公債回購規模提高至至少40億美元，但媒體報導此前市場預期規模至少會達到100億美元。
美國10年期公債殖利率上升3.5個基點至4.839%。在財政部公布消息前，殖利率僅上升1.2個基點至4.816%。對利率更加敏感的美國2年期公債殖利率則上升2.7個基點至4.425%。
財政部的回購行動原本被視為一項意外的干預措施，目的是限制美國公債殖利率持續飆升的走勢，而美債近期一直遭遇大規模拋售。
此次美債拋售受到多重因素推動，包括油價飆升引發的通膨疑慮、企業為支應人工智慧基礎建設而大舉發債所帶來的市場擔憂，以及對美國國債規模持續膨脹的疑慮。
布魯金斯研究院經濟研究資深研究員Robin Brooks表示，「試圖透過公債回購等方式，人為壓低長期殖利率的問題在於，如果市場認為回購規模太小，殖利率反而會跳升。這顯示市場底層的上行壓力非常強勁。」
目前市場正密切等待周四公布的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)及周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，以尋找進一步的利率線索。如果通膨數據高於預期，可能使市場對聯準會下周升息的預期明顯升溫。
日元持續徘徊逾七個月高點
日元已成為主要貨幣中表現最亮眼貨幣，光是9月以來就上漲4%。本月初開始的強勁漲勢，周二一度推動日元升至152.89兌1美元的高點。周三日元延續升勢，美元兌日元下跌0.2%，至153.63。
日元受到日本銀行政策收緊預期及市場廣泛猜測日本政府可能再次干預匯市等因素支撐。金融市場幾乎已確定日本銀行將於9月18日升息25個基點，交易員也認為，日本銀行總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)可能暗示年底前還會進一步推動貨幣政策正常化。
LPL Financial技術策略師Adam Turnquist周二表示，「日元的漲勢反映出基本面與技術面真正發生轉變，日銀正進一步走向政策正常化，同時突破原有趨勢。投資人應密切關注152這個關鍵價位，若日元明確突破該支撐並進一步升值，可能加速日元漲勢、迫使更多空頭回補，並重新引發日元套利交易平倉的風險，進而對包括美國公債在內的全球資產產生連鎖影響。」
本周稍早公布的官方數據顯示，日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元。外匯存底的大幅下降，直接為東京規模達15兆日元(976.7億美元)的匯市干預行動提供資金，其中部分行動是與美國同步進行。
其他貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1629美元。
歐洲央行幾乎已被市場一致預期，周四將升息25個基點。
德意志銀行Jim Reid表示，「市場確實可以討論，在供給衝擊之下，歐洲央行是否應該繼續升息……但市場顯然認為，央行的政策反應函數與能源價格高度相關，近期油價與天然氣價格上漲，使市場對最終利率的定價達到3%。」
他補充，「因此，明天升息基本上已經確定，但接下來的情況就會變得更加複雜。如果能源價格維持在目前水準，經濟成長應該會受到影響，但到目前為止，實際影響遠沒有市場原先預期的那麼大，因此歐洲央行面臨的高度不確定性必須受到重視。」

paras_en: The dollar changed little on Wednesday (the 9th), with market attention still on the yen, which has surged sharply in recent weeks. Forex participants are preparing for a pivotal moment as the European Central Bank (ECB) will announce its rate decision this week, and the Federal Reserve (Fed) and Bank of Japan (BoJ) will release their decisions next week.
The U.S. Treasury market is also in focus; after the Treasury released an eagerly awaited update on its bond repurchase operations, the size disappointed investors.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 98.83.

The U.S. Treasury announced a repurchase of $6 billion of Treasury bonds with maturities of 10 to 20 years, higher than the previously announced $2 billion. After the news, the market sold off Treasuries, and Treasury yields jumped sharply.
Last month the Treasury said it would raise the repurchase size to at least $4 billion, but media reports noted that the market had previously expected the size to be at least $10 billion.

The 10‑year Treasury yield rose 3.5 basis points to 4.839%. Before the Treasury’s announcement, the yield had risen only 1.2 basis points to 4.816%. The more rate‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield climbed 2.7 basis points to 4.425%.
The repurchase action was originally seen as an unexpected intervention aimed at curbing the continued surge in Treasury yields, as Treasuries have recently faced large‑scale selling.

The recent Treasury sell‑off was driven by multiple factors, including inflation worries sparked by soaring oil prices, market concerns over corporations issuing massive debt to fund AI infrastructure, and doubts about the ever‑expanding size of U.S. government debt.

Robin Brooks, senior economist at the Brookings Institution, said, "The problem with trying to artificially lower long‑term yields through repurchases is that if the market thinks the repurchase size is too small, yields can actually jump. This shows that the underlying upward pressure in the market is very strong."

The market is now closely awaiting Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) and Friday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) for further rate clues. If inflation data comes in hotter than expected, expectations for a Fed rate hike next week could rise sharply.
The yen continues to hover near a seven‑month high.

The yen has become the best‑performing major currency, up 4% since September. A strong rally that began early this month pushed the yen to a high of 152.89 per dollar on Tuesday. On Wednesday the yen kept climbing, with USD/JPY down 0.2% to 153.63.

The yen is being supported by expectations of tighter Bank of Japan policy and widespread speculation that the Japanese government may intervene in the FX market again. The financial markets are almost certain that the BoJ will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 18, and traders also think BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda may hint at further policy normalization before year‑end.

Adam Turnquist, technology strategist at LPL Financial, said on Tuesday, "The yen’s rally reflects a real shift in fundamentals and technicals, with the BoJ moving further toward policy normalization and breaking its previous trend. Investors should watch the key level of 152 closely; if the yen decisively breaks that support and appreciates further, it could accelerate the rally, force more short covering, and reignite the risk of yen‑carry‑trade unwind, which could have cascading effects on global assets, including U.S. Treasuries."

Official data released earlier this week showed that Japan’s August foreign‑securities holdings fell by a record $87.8 billion. The sharp drop in foreign‑exchange reserves directly funds Tokyo’s ¥15 trillion (about $97.67 billion) FX‑intervention capacity, some of which is coordinated with the United States.
Among other currencies, the euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1629.
The ECB is almost unanimously expected by the market to raise rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, "The market can indeed discuss whether, under a supply shock, the ECB should keep raising rates… but the market clearly sees the ECB’s policy response function as highly linked to energy prices. Recent spikes in oil and gas have pushed market pricing of the final rate to about 3%."

He added, "Therefore, a rate hike tomorrow is basically a given, but what follows will become more complex. If energy prices stay at current levels, economic growth should be affected, but so far the real impact has been far less than markets originally expected, so the high uncertainty facing the ECB must be taken seriously."
